# Engine Management and Fuel Trim – ASE Practice Question (VIDEO)


#### Description


Technician A says that the ECM’s primary role in engine management is to ensure that emissions remain within the limits for which the vehicle was originally certified. Technician B says that the fuel trim data PIDs (Parameter Identifiers) represent corrections made to the ECM’s fuel calculations.


**Who is correct?**
A) Technician A
B) Technician B
C) Both Technician A and B
D) Neither Technician A or B
